observations: Third-reader verified inventory. All 4 original screenshots, the 4 pre-rendered criteria zooms, the 4 list zooms and 7 extra crops at 3x-7x (prefix C_ in the zoom folder) were read. Readers A and B agreed on every report, section, control, option, default value, enabled state and truncation flag (4 reports, 11 controls); they differed only in descriptive wording. Everything was nevertheless re-checked on the pixels: a whole-image scan of each screenshot for every cluster of non-background pixels found exactly the elements listed here and nothing else (no 'Page Break', no right-edge or second-column extras, no greyed-out control, no instruction or legend text, no scrollbar, no footer text); numeric pixel checks confirmed the filled radios, the empty checkboxes and the SECURITY GROUP header glyphs. COVERAGE: 4 screenshots = 4 different reports of the same screen, each selected exactly once: 1.PNG User List, 2.PNG Group List, 3.PNG Group Rights List, 4.PNG User-Group Membership. No popups, expanded dropdowns or scrolled views. TITLE BAR: 'Security List Reports' at left; identifiers 'PGID :2829 / OID :108' at right, followed by an unlabeled white printer icon at the far right edge (present in all 4 screenshots; not part of the criteria area and not counted as an action). LEFT PANEL 'SELECT REPORT': a SINGLE column of exactly four full-width radio rows separated by thin white lines, with a large empty dark area below; no second column, no scrollbar, not clipped - the list is complete. A vertical splitter/collapse handle (three dots between two notches) sits on the border between the left and right panels at mid-height. RIGHT PANEL 'REPORT CRITERIA': grey section-header bars each followed by a lighter control row, all in one column; the 'CLEAR CRITERIA' button (grey/slate fill, white text, refresh/circular-arrows icon) sits at the right end of the blue REPORT CRITERIA header bar - grey is its styling in every screenshot, not evidence of a disabled state. Bottom action band (right aligned): 'PRINT / PREVIEW' (printer icon) and 'ADD TO MY FAVORITES' (plus icon), both blue. RECURRING PATTERNS: every report starts with PRINT FORMAT = PDF (default) / Excel. Group List and Group Rights List have nothing but PRINT FORMAT. User List adds USER (User picker, ALL) and OTHER OPTIONS (Include Inactive Users, unchecked). User-Group Membership adds REPORT FORMAT (Detail default / Summary), SECURITY GROUP (Group picker, ALL), LOCATION (Office default / Office Group radios plus a label-less picker showing 108) and OTHER OPTIONS (Include Inactive Users, unchecked). Picker rows are a read-only grey box plus a blue SELECT button whose icon varies by entity (user-plus for User, group of people for Group, building for Location). No date range, sort-by, group-by or page-break controls appear anywhere in this category. No control is greyed out or disabled in any screenshot. CAPTURE ARTIFACTS (outside the report window, no readable text): 1.PNG has a 4 px blue strip above the title bar with a small white-outlined rectangle fragment at the top-left corner (x 0-26) - the cropped bottom edge of the application chrome above; 1.PNG, 2.PNG and 3.PNG end with a plain grey strip carrying one darker 1 px line across the full width below the window (uniform across all 1366 px, so it is a frame border, not a scrollbar); the last pixel row of 3.PNG has two 3 px pinkish specks near x 1342-1350 (top edge of something cropped below); 4.PNG is cropped just below the action band. Screenshot sizes: 1366 px wide, 583-598 px tall. All text was legible after zooming; no uncertain readings remain.

dynamic_rules.effect: The SELECT picker chooses office groups defined in Setup > Office Groups (for example regions) instead of offices; when no office groups are defined, a group run covers all offices of the account. This is the OFFICE/GROUP control of the other Lists screens, headed LOCATION on this report - the only Security List report that has it. The vendor documents the behaviour for the Office / Office Group control in general; the report itself is absent from vendor documentation, hence likely.
dynamic_rules.evidence_quote: `Office Group` picks groups defined in `Setup > Office Groups` (for example regions); without groups a group run covers all offices of the account. On `User-Group Membership` the same control is headed `LOCATION`.

corrections.text: The number in the LOCATION box is not a fixed default: with the Office radio the box defaults to the current office (the OID of the session, the same number the title bar shows) and SELECT picks other offices. Stated by the vendor for the Office / Office Group control in general, of which LOCATION is the instance on this report.

What a security group is, i.e. what the Group picker chooses from: security groups are defined per office (the same group name can exist under several offices), and a user has a primary group plus optional additional groups - so one user can appear under several groups. Vendor-documented for security groups; that the picker lists them follows from the name of the criterion.
corrections.evidence_quote: Defined per office; holds rights named `<Area> - <Function>` with `Full Control` / `View Only` variants; a user has a primary group plus optional additional groups.

supplement_unresolved.question: Older build: a vendor screenshot of c. 2023 shows REPORT FORMAT Detail (default) / Summary on User List, between PRINT FORMAT and USER. Our 2026 capture (complete) has no REPORT FORMAT, so it is not added. Where did the Summary format (a list of usernames) go?

Older builds: the 2016 / 2019 screen of Group Rights List had Detail / Summary and an Office multi-select (default ALL); the 2023 screen had PRINT FORMAT and REPORT FORMAT Detail (default) / Summary with no office filter; our 2026 capture has PRINT FORMAT only. None of these is added - confirm that the current report really takes no filter.

User-Group Membership is absent from the vendor's 2023 screenshots of this screen and from every article: what REPORT FORMAT Detail / Summary change, and how the Group picker, LOCATION and Include Inactive Users filter the members, is inferred only.

The Security List screen is evidently still changing between builds (three reports on the 2023 vendor screenshots, four in our 2026 capture, REPORT FORMAT moved); our capture is one tenant on one date.
